goal: highest-efficiency score improvement with up to two Kaggle submissions
conclusions: Replacing part or all of the old Transformer and using the stronger in-house RealMLP raised displayed public LB from 0.149 to 0.150.
Deep3 Transformer underperformed the two-layer baseline and was rejected.
The 379-feature XGBoost improved the tree standalone score substantially but received zero optimal weight in the locally verifiable strong trio.
The two submitted replacement ratios tied at leaderboard precision; retain both artifacts and prefer the full-replacement file as the final evidence-backed candidate.
